events.headline: US-Iran 60-day truce deadline expired Aug 17 with no deal; Trump says he will not try to revive it, raising risk of Iran shifting to an offensive posture in the Gulf/Strait of Hormuz
Crude climbs for a third straight session on Gulf supply risk: Brent ~$89/bbl, WTI ~$83-85/bbl, with roughly 8.3 mb/d of Gulf output still shut in

30-year US Treasury yield hit ~5.31-5.33%, a 19-year high (highest since 2007), on worsening fiscal deficit outlook and inflation stuck above the Fed's target; markets now price possible 2026 rate hikes rather than cuts

Broad tech/chip selloff pressured Nasdaq on Aug 19 (capital rotating out of high-growth names, TSMC trading well above fair-value estimates) even as underlying AI chip demand stays strong (Micron launches $250M AI investment fund; chip supply chain tightness seen persisting through year-end)
